features.title: Initialize Express server
features.description: Create a basic Express.js server with GET /health endpoint on port 3000. Run npm init -y and install express. Create src/index.js as entry point. Configure Express to serve static files from public/.

features.title: Blog post CRUD API
features.description: Implement REST endpoints for blog posts: GET /api/posts (list all), POST /api/posts (create), GET /api/posts/:id (get one), PUT /api/posts/:id (update), DELETE /api/posts/:id (delete). Use in-memory array storage. Each post has: id (uuid), title (string), content (string), author (string), createdAt (ISO date), updatedAt (ISO date).
features.notes: Can run in PARALLEL with F-003

features.title: User authentication API
features.description: Implement JWT-based auth: POST /api/auth/register (email + password, hash with bcrypt), POST /api/auth/login (returns JWT token), GET /api/auth/me (returns current user from JWT). Use in-memory user store. Install jsonwebtoken and bcryptjs. Create auth middleware that validates JWT from Authorization header.
features.notes: Can run in PARALLEL with F-002

features.title: Login page
features.description: Create public/login.html with email/password form. On submit, POST to /api/auth/login, store JWT in localStorage. On success, redirect to /index.html. Show error message on failure. Add a link to register page. Use vanilla JS fetch.

features.title: Blog post list page
features.description: Create public/index.html with a list of blog posts fetched from GET /api/posts. Each post shows title, author, date, and a truncated content preview. Add a 'New Post' button (visible only when logged in) that opens a form to create a post via POST /api/posts with JWT auth header. Include edit/delete buttons per post for the post author.
features.notes: Can run in PARALLEL with F-004

features.title: Comment system
features.description: Add commenting to blog posts. Backend: POST /api/posts/:id/comments (requires auth, body: {content}), GET /api/posts/:id/comments (public). Frontend: on each post's detail view, show a comment form (if logged in) and a list of existing comments with author and date. Use in-memory storage for comments. Each comment has: id, postId, author, content, createdAt.
features.notes: Diamond merge point — depends on both F-002 and F-003
